paite: Kinakna toh a-inn dim a nopbawl sang in tanghou gaw a muanna toh om ahoihzaw.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

paite: Sikha piltak a hih in tapa zumhuaina omsak tung ah vai ahawm ding, huan unaute lak a goutanna ah tan anei ding hi.
english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

paite: Huansianna bel zaw dangka a ding ahi, huan meipi dangka-eng a ding; himahleh TOUPA'N lungtangte a-endik hi.
english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.

paite: Hoih lou hihmi'n gilou mukte alimsak a; huan zuauhat in siatna lei abildoh hi.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei musit in amah Bawlpa asimmoh a; huan kuapeuh tuahsiat ni a kipak gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

paite: Tate' tate mi upate lallukhu ahi uh; huan tate thupina apate uh ahi.
english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

paite: Thugen hoih mihai toh akilawm kei; muk zuauthei lal toh akilawm kei sem hi.
english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

paite: Anei mit ah thilpiak suangmantam bang ahi; koilam peuh a akiheina ah, alohching hi.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

paite: Kuapeuh tatlekna khuh in itna azong hi; himahleh kuapeuh thubuai a nuamsa in lawmte akhendalh hi.
english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

paite: Mihai sung a vuakna zakhat sang in theihsiamna neimi sung ah taina alut thukzaw.
english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

paite: Mihoih lou in helna kia azong a; huaiziak in sawltak khel amah dou ding a sawl in a-om ding hi.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

paite: Vompi anoute laksak a om in mi tuak hen, ahaina a mihai sang in.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

paite: Kuapeuh hoih sik a gilou kipahman pia, a-inn a kipan gilou apaimang kei ding.
english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

paite: Kinakna kipatna mi'n tui akhahkhiak bang ahi; huaiziak in kinakna a-om ma in, kiselna paisan in.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

paite: Kuapeuh gilou siamtangsak, kuapeuh midiktat mohpaih, amau gel TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi tuaktuak uhi.
english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in pilna lei ding in mihai khut ah aman a-om a hia, theihsiamna anei kei chih thei in?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

paite: Lawm in chik lai peuh in a-it gige a, huan vangtah ni a ding in unau khat apiang hi.
english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

paite: Mi theihsiamna bei in khut abeng a, invengte ma ah moh khu ding in ahong om hi.
english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

paite: Kinakna deih in tatlekna adeih hi; kuapeuh akongpi domsang in siatna azong hi.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

paite: Kuapeuh lungtang sia nei in hoih amu kei; huan siatna ah lei hoih lou nei apuk hi.
english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

paite: Kuapeuh mihai suang in alungkhamna ding in asuang; huan mihaipa'n nopsakna anei kei hi.
english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

paite: Lungtang nuamsa damdawi hoih ahi; himahleh lungsim puakkham in guhte akeusak.
english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

paite: Migilou in angsung a kipan in thilpiak alakhia a, vaihawmna lampi heikawisak ding in.
english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

paite: Theihsiamna neimi ma ah pilna a-om; himahleh mihai mitte lei tawp ah a-om hi.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

paite: Apa a ding in tapa hai lungkhamna ahi a, amah piangsaknu a ding in khatna ahi.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

paite: Midiktat gawt hiam thutak ziak a milian zep leng ahoih kei hi.
english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

paite: Kuapeuh theihna neimi akamsim thei hi; kuapeuh theihsiamna nei lungsim tawldam in a-om hi.
english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

paite: Mihai nangawn, adaih dide lai in, pil a ngaih ahi; amukte achih lai in, pilvang bang a theih ahi.
english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
